## The XCELL PRP System is Now Supported by Published Clinical Data

A peer-reviewed study evaluating the XCELL PRP System has been published in Bioengineering,
demonstrating consistent platelet recovery, customizable PRP formulations, and significant red blood
cell reduction using XCELL's single-spin technology.

## Regenerative Medicine Solutions

FDA-registered Class II PRP system engineered for precision and performance


APEX Biologix offers a comprehensive portfolio of FDA-registered Class II autologous biologic
systems, including Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), Protein Concentrate (A2M), and Bone Marrow
Concentrate (BMC). Engineered for precision, efficiency, and reproducibility, XCELL platforms are
designed to optimize biologic yield, streamline processing, and reduce variability while supporting
advanced regenerative medicine applications across orthopedics, sports medicine, interventional
pain, integrative care, and aesthetics.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

immune system to target and attack cancer. Our CAR T-cell therapy manufacturing process includes
these 5 steps:

STEP 1

### Collect

patient's white
blood cells
STEP 2

### Isolate

and activate
the T cells

### Engineer

the T cells with a chimeric
antigen receptor (CAR) gene

number of T cells

Our Therapies

### Singular Focus of Cell Therapy

CAR T-cell therapy is a custom-made, one-time cancer treatment that is designed to work by
engineering a patient’s own white blood cells and harnessing their immune system to treat certain
kinds of blood cancer.

    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

StatSeal^{®} Disc Products for Indwelling Catheters

Minimize dressing disruption with StatSeal^{®} Disc products, a novel solution to procedural site
care and maintenance.

WoundSeal^{®} Occupational Health Products

Essential for any first aid kit, WoundSeal^{®} Occupational Health products are provided in portable
pouch packaging, ideal for both first aid cabinets and for workers on the go who may not have access
to the first aid cabinet.

StatSeal^{®} Advanced Powder

StatSeal^{®} Advanced Powder helps achieve fast, consistent hemostasis on multiple puncture sites
and large bore sheath removals, drastically shortening recovery time, even on patients prone to
bleeding.

WoundSeal^{®} First Aid Consumer Products

WoundSeal^{®} Powder can give you confidence and peace of mind to know that you can stop bleeding
wherever you go in just seconds. Plus, it’s safe for all ages and even works for people who bleed
easily.

StatSeal Advanced RAD for Radial Procedures

StatSeal^{®} Advanced RAD Disc, in conjunction with manual pressure or any radial hemostasis band,
can help standardize, simplify and shorten the recovery process to under an hour, while minimizing
complications.

Our medical device products help improve quality of life.

Biolife products work with any protein-rich body fluid to create an instant, occlusive seal over
procedural sites and wounds to stop oozing and bleeding. Biolife products do not rely on the body’s
natural clotting mechanism to be effective, making them especially useful for people prone to
bleeding.

### Welcome to Cell Therapy 360^{®}: Your Partner Throughout the CAR T Cell Therapy Treatment
### Journey

**Cell Therapy 360 provides support for patients and providers to help throughout the cell therapy
treatment process.**

It's part of our commitment to connecting patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers to helpful
resources throughout the treatment experience.

For information about enrolling a patient in Cell Therapy 360, **[proceed to registration
details][48].**

CAR=chimeric antigen receptor.

#### Cell Therapy 360 Tools for Healthcare Professionals

Resources to help initiate a patient’s Bristol Myers Squibb CAR T cell therapy

**[CAR T Treatment Center Locator][49]**

Use an interactive map to find a treatment center near you.

**[Insurance Lookup Tool][50]**

Search insurance coverage details for CAR T cell therapy.

**[Access & Reimbursement Support][51]**

See access information and other support resources.






 

#### Cell Therapy 360 Personalized End-to-End Support

Cell Therapy 360 offers support to patients who have been prescribed a Bristol Myers Squibb CAR T
cell therapy product. Program offerings include:

**Patient Support Navigator**

We’re here to answer any Bristol Myers Squibb CAR T cell therapy questions you may have. A
knowledgeable Cell Therapy 360 team member is available 24/7 to answer questions about the treatment
journey.

**Logistical support**

Cell Therapy 360 may be able to support eligible patients* and a caregiver with transportation,
lodging, and meal assistance throughout the patient journey.

Contact the call line to learn more about enrollment and Cell Therapy 360 support:

[**1-888-805-4555**][52]
*Eligibility requirements apply.

**Financial support**

Through the Copay Assistance Program, Cell Therapy 360 can cover out-of-pocket expenses for
commercially insured patients who have been prescribed a Bristol Myers Squibb CAR T cell therapy
product.^{†
}^{†}The program is not available for patients who are enrolled in Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, the
Veterans Affairs (VA), or any other federal or state healthcare program. The program will cover the
out-of-pocket expenses of the Bristol Myers Squibb product only. Limitations apply.  It does not
cover the costs of any other healthcare provider charges or any other treatment costs. Patients are
responsible for non-drug-related out-of-pocket costs. Additional eligibility requirements may apply.
Bristol Myers Squibb reserves the right to rescind, revoke, or amend this program without notice.

For more information on the available support resources, **[visit our Patients and Caregivers
page.][53]**

#### **Enrollment, Scheduling, and Apheresis Portal**

An all-in-one, easy-to-use tool that helps providers get their patients started at certified CAR T
cell therapy treatment centers.

[Access the Portal][54]

# 
# Accelerating the future of medicine

At Kytopen, we seek to expand patient access to the next generation of living medicines through
scalable genome engineering platforms by solving cell therapy manufacturing problems at the
discovery stage.

Our non-viral gene delivery platform empowers researchers and developers to accelerate drug
discovery, expedite optimization, and remove barriers to biomanufacturing scaling.

[[Untitled design (88)]][28]
[ICO]

#### KYTOPEN enables efficient cell engineering from discovery through manufacturing

## Technology

Translatable gene delivery across all phases of development

[Flowfect]

Flowfect^{®} technology combines continuous fluid flow with electric fields for high- efficiency
delivery of payloads such as mRNA, DNA, and CRISPR Cas9 RNP to billions of cells in minutes.

The Flowfect^{®} technology continuous process enables unprecedented customization to finetune the
delivery of genome engineering materials to cells and allows predictive scaling from small volume
transfections to the manufacturing scale. 

AUTOMATED
HIGH THROUGHPUT
DISCOVERY

Whether you’re optimizing transfection conditions or discovering a next-generation cell therapy,
Flowfect^{®} technology allows you to investigate and scale with confidence.

**Unlock unprecedented control with multiple parameters to fine-tune delivery for up to 96 samples
in a single experiment within minutes.**

[Kytopen]
[Kytopen]

SCALABLE
CELL ENGINEERING

Save time and lower costs of scaling new therapeutic products by eliminating the gene delivery
bottleneck at discovery.

**Flowfect****® technology enables predictive scaling from small-volume, low-cost optimization
experiments to large-volume manufacturing.**

UNPARALLELED & EFFICIENT
OPTIMIZATION

Combining electrical, mechanical, and chemical forces for gene delivery introduces multiple modes of
influencing transport and interactions to fine-tune engineered cell yields.

Translate optimized parameters between small-volume transfections to large-scale manufacturing with
confidence.

[Kytopen]

## Our platform

Scale with confidence using a single technology

Save time and reduce costs to scaling cell therapies by utilizing the same singular technology.
Explore, discover, and optimize gene delivery before transitioning to large-scale development.

FLOWFECT DISCOVER^{™} PLATFORM

is an automated small-volume liquid-handling platform capable of performing high-throughput
transfections for drug discovery, screening, and process optimization.
* **Retain cell functionality**: Utilizes continuous flow transfection
  
* **Easy to integrate**: Compatible with standard liquid handling consumables such as HSP9655
  96-well plates 
  
* **Unparalleled & efficient optimization**: Capable of running to up 96 separate conditions in a
  single run about 10 minutes for sample volumes ranging from 50-100µL

For research use only. Not for use in clinical or diagnostic procedures

[ [Learn More] ][29]
[Untitled design (84)-1]
[Untitled design (86)-1]

FLOWFECT TX^{® }PLATFORM

is a closed-system transfection instrument that enables large-scale payload delivery to billions of
cells within minutes.

* **Retain cell functionality**: Utilizes continuous flow transfection
  
* **Easy to integrate**: Compatible with standard cell therapy and off-the-shelf bioprocessing bags 
  
* **Flexibility in volume and delivery speed**: Process 10-50 million cells per mL at 25-50 mL per
  minute, no batch volume limitations

For research use only. Not for use in clinical or diagnostic procedures

## We See Health Differently

Dr. Matt Cook is a global thought leader and innovator in [regenerative medicine][49]. With over 20
years dedicated to advancing functional and regenerative treatments, he has developed a proprietary
multimodal approach that harnesses the body's natural healing power to address complex injuries and
cellular-level regeneration. All of our practitioners have trained under his guidance, ensuring you
receive precision medicine tailored to you.

For too long, medicine has focused on treating symptoms instead of finding solutions. At BioReset
Medical, we use [advanced therapies][50] and regenerative treatments to help your body heal from the
inside out. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working to
optimize your health, we create a personalized plan that works for you—not just a one-size-fits-all
treatment.

We don’t just treat patients - we teach doctors worldwide. As leaders in [ultrasound-guided
therapies][51] and [regenerative medicine][52], we train physicians through BioReset University,
ensuring that the most effective techniques are shared across the globe.

[Dr. Matt Cook, founder of BioReset Medical.]

your body’s natural healing processes. At BioReset Medical, our concierge model ensures you receive
direct access to world-class specialists, priority scheduling, and fully personalized treatment
plans.
‍

Whether you’re managing chronic pain, recovering from injury, or optimizing healthspan, our team
crafts solutions that address your unique needs - so you can reclaim your mobility, vitality, and
confidence.

**Benefits** **of Regenerative Concierge Care:

- Personalized Precision **Every treatment plan is custom-designed using advanced diagnostics and
one-on-one expert guidance.

**-** **Non-Surgical Relief **Minimally invasive therapies promote tissue regeneration and reduce
pain without the risks of surgery.

**-** **Seamless Concierge Experience **Direct access to specialists, immediate appointment
availability, and holistic support from consultation through recovery.

WoundSeal^{®} Powder can give you confidence and peace of mind to know that you can stop bleeding
wherever you go in just seconds. Plus, it’s safe for all ages and even works for people who bleed
easily.

StatSeal Advanced RAD for Radial Procedures

StatSeal^{®} Advanced RAD Disc, in conjunction with manual pressure or any radial hemostasis band,
can help standardize, simplify and shorten the recovery process to under an hour, while minimizing
complications.

NEWS

Merit Acquires Biolife Delaware, LLC, Maker of StatSeal^{®} & WoundSeal^{®} Medical Device Products

[ Read More ][32]
Our medical device products help improve quality of life.

Biolife products work with any protein-rich body fluid to create an instant, occlusive seal over
procedural sites and wounds to stop oozing and bleeding. Biolife products do not rely on the body’s
natural clotting mechanism to be effective, making them especially useful for people prone to
bleeding.

[ Professional
Healthcare ][33]

StatSeal^{®} hemostatic products help standardize, simplify and minimize post-procedure care
following any procedure resulting in external bleeding and oozing.

[ Occupational
Health ][34]
Essential for any first aid kit, WoundSeal^{®} Powder is provided in portable pouch packaging, ideal
for both first aid cabinets and for workers on the go.
[ Consumer
Health ][35]

WoundSeal^{®} Powder is a consumer first aid solution that stops bleeding instantly, is safe and
effective for all ages, and even works for people who bleed easily.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

Each cell therapy we develop is uniquely designed for each patient, harnessing the power of the
immune system to target and attack cancer. Our CAR T-cell therapy manufacturing process includes
these 5 steps:

STEP 1

### Collect

patient's white
blood cells
STEP 2

### Isolate

and activate
the T cells
STEP 3

### Engineer

the T cells with a chimeric
antigen receptor (CAR) gene
STEP 4

### Grow

and expand the
number of T cells
STEP 5

### Infuse

the same patient with
engineered T cells

engineering a patient’s own white blood cells and harnessing their immune system to treat certain
kinds of blood cancer.

Our process

## Cell Therapy Explained in 5 Steps

Each cell therapy we develop is uniquely designed for each patient, harnessing the power of the
immune system to target and attack cancer. Our CAR T-cell therapy manufacturing process includes
these 5 steps:

STEP 1

### Collect

patient's white
blood cells
STEP 2

### Isolate

and activate
the T cells
STEP 3

### Engineer

the T cells with a chimeric
antigen receptor (CAR) gene
STEP 4

### Grow

and expand the
number of T cells
STEP 5

### Infuse

the same patient with
engineered T cells
[Learn More About Our
Cell Therapy Technology][46]
[Therapy]
Our Therapies

### Singular Focus of Cell Therapy

CAR T-cell therapy is a custom-made, one-time cancer treatment that is designed to work by
engineering a patient’s own white blood cells and harnessing their immune system to treat certain
kinds of blood cancer.

[Discover Our Therapies ][47]
our pipeline

### Pushing Forward

Our broad and diversified pipeline includes research to discover novel ways to improve patients’
responses to cell therapy, different cell therapy modalities, and ways to increase the speed of our
manufacturing efforts.

[See Our Pipeline ][48]

Our careers

### Help Cure Cancer With Us

We’re looking for people who want to accomplish what was once thought impossible: finding cures for
cancer. If you’re passionate about advancing the next generation of cell therapy treatment, find
your career at Kite.

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Slide 1

# Groundbreaking innovations are reshaping the world of medicine

Caring Cross aims to lower the cost and change how advanced therapies are made and delivered to
patients that need them. We are developing therapies to treat Leukemia, Lymphoma, HIV and Sickle
Cell Disease.

[
Learn More
][35]
Slide 2

# Breakthroughs in medicine have resulted in new life-saving advanced therapies

We work directly with hospitals to manufacture the products at the place of care so that all needing
these transformative therapies are able to access them in an affordable manner.

[
Learn More
][36]
Slide 3

# We collaborate with a diverse network of academic institutions and organizations

Through these partnerships, we leverage complementary expertise, share resources, and accelerate the
translation of research discoveries into clinical applications.

[
Learn More
][37]

#### Here’s what drives us:

## 37 Million

people living with HIV/AIDS worldwide (1.8 million children).

## 18 Million

new cancer cases in 2018 with 9.5 million deaths worldwide.

## $350,000+

Is the cost of a CAR-T cell therapy for Lymphoma, not including hospital costs.

Potentially life-saving advanced therapies are available, but they are neither affordable nor
accessible to millions of patients.

#### Access to life-saving advanced therapies should be a human right for all in need, not just for
#### the privileged few.

#### Here’s how we do it:

[puzzle pieces]

### Safe, effective and affordable advanced therapies.

We develop improved advanced therapies and innovative manufacturing processes to lower their cost.

[Collaboration - icon]

### Strategic collaboration.

We partner with a diverse array of stakeholders that support our vision of affordable access to
advanced therapies worldwide.

[people]

### Enabling access.

We support hospitals and health systems to manufacture advanced therapy products close to where
patients come for care, improving access.

[background]

## Every person should be able to access affordable advanced medicines.

#### Here’s how you can help:

### [Partner with us.][38]

#### Here’s what drives us:

## 37 Million

people living with HIV/AIDS worldwide (1.8 million children).

## 18 Million

new cancer cases in 2018 with 9.5 million deaths worldwide.

## $350,000+

Is the cost of a CAR-T cell therapy for Lymphoma, not including hospital costs.

Potentially life-saving advanced therapies are available, but they are neither affordable nor
accessible to millions of patients.

#### Access to life-saving advanced therapies should be a human right for all in need, not just for
#### the privileged few.

#### Here’s how we do it:

[puzzle pieces]

### Safe, effective and affordable advanced therapies.

We develop improved advanced therapies and innovative manufacturing processes to lower their cost.

[Collaboration - icon]

### Strategic collaboration.

We partner with a diverse array of stakeholders that support our vision of affordable access to
advanced therapies worldwide.

[people]

### Enabling access.

We support hospitals and health systems to manufacture advanced therapy products close to where
patients come for care, improving access.

[background]

## Two proprietary AI platforms — driving the process end to end.

**Oracle** is our cell therapy operating system — taking any disease as input and producing the
optimal stem cell type, QC release framework, and bioreactor blueprint in seconds rather than the
months required by traditional methods.

**Delfi** is our pharmaceutical R&D decision engine — covering candidate identification, clinical
trial operations, and full go/no-go decision support for biologics and small molecules.

Together, Oracle and Delfi systematize the high-risk decisions — toxicity prediction, manufacturing
at scale, patient selection, trial design, regulatory strategy — that determine whether new
medicines reach patients.

tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs), and human pluripotent stem cells and their derivatives.

Our technology transfer framework enables efficient onboarding of complex cell therapy programs into
our GMP facility. We apply a phase-appropriate, risk-based approach across six gated stages from

continuity and reducing transition risk.

### Journey

**Cell Therapy 360 provides support for patients and providers to help throughout the cell therapy
treatment process.**

It's part of our commitment to connecting patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers to helpful
resources throughout the treatment experience.

For information about enrolling a patient in Cell Therapy 360, **[proceed to registration
details][48].**

CAR=chimeric antigen receptor.

#### Cell Therapy 360 Tools for Healthcare Professionals

Resources to help initiate a patient’s Bristol Myers Squibb CAR T cell therapy

**[CAR T Treatment Center Locator][49]**

Use an interactive map to find a treatment center near you.

**[Insurance Lookup Tool][50]**

Search insurance coverage details for CAR T cell therapy.

**[Access & Reimbursement Support][51]**

See access information and other support resources.






 

#### Cell Therapy 360 Personalized End-to-End Support

Cell Therapy 360 offers support to patients who have been prescribed a Bristol Myers Squibb CAR T
cell therapy product. Program offerings include:

**Patient Support Navigator**

We’re here to answer any Bristol Myers Squibb CAR T cell therapy questions you may have. A
knowledgeable Cell Therapy 360 team member is available 24/7 to answer questions about the treatment
journey.

**Logistical support**

Cell Therapy 360 may be able to support eligible patients* and a caregiver with transportation,
lodging, and meal assistance throughout the patient journey.

Contact the call line to learn more about enrollment and Cell Therapy 360 support:

[**1-888-805-4555**][52]
*Eligibility requirements apply.

**Financial support**

Through the Copay Assistance Program, Cell Therapy 360 can cover out-of-pocket expenses for
commercially insured patients who have been prescribed a Bristol Myers Squibb CAR T cell therapy
product.^{†
}^{†}The program is not available for patients who are enrolled in Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, the
Veterans Affairs (VA), or any other federal or state healthcare program. The program will cover the
out-of-pocket expenses of the Bristol Myers Squibb product only. Limitations apply.  It does not
cover the costs of any other healthcare provider charges or any other treatment costs. Patients are
responsible for non-drug-related out-of-pocket costs. Additional eligibility requirements may apply.
Bristol Myers Squibb reserves the right to rescind, revoke, or amend this program without notice.

For more information on the available support resources, **[visit our Patients and Caregivers
page.][53]**

An all-in-one, easy-to-use tool that helps providers get their patients started at certified CAR T
cell therapy treatment centers.

# Where Cell Therapy Innovation Meets Acceleration

CTMC offers fully integrated 360° Solutions combined with a patient-adjacent manufacturing model
with The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center.

We are so much more than a CDMO.

## Minimizing Risk.
## Accelerating Time to Clinic.
## Maximizing Value.

CTMC’s co-development model accelerates cell therapy programs to clinical proof-of-concept faster
and more efficiently than traditional approaches.

By integrating development, manufacturing, and digital infrastructure into a unified BioSolutions
platform, we reduce execution risk, preserve capital, and create earlier value inflection, giving
investors, researchers, and biotech a clearer, faster path to patients.

## Our 360° Solutions deliver the full suite of capabilities needed to transform groundbreaking
## science into clinical reality – faster, smarter, and all in one place.

[BioSolutions]

### BioSolutions

Comprehensive model to accelerate cell therapy from research to clinical
* **Integrated manufacturing capabilities** — from viral vector production to CAR-T, NK, and TIL
  therapies, all under one roof.
* **Seamless, holistic solutions** — guiding programs from early development through clinical trials
  to commercialization.
* **Comprehensive, bundled expertise** — uniting development, regulatory, clinical, and operational
  support to streamline progress to patients.

[Integrated]

### BioExpertise

Decades of specialized cell therapy experience in the lab and the clinic
* **Collaborative team of scientists, specialists, and technicians** blending deep academic insight
  with proven industrial expertise.
* **Trailblazers in TIL therapy** advancing innovative platforms, technologies, and manufacturing
  processes through our proprietary reagents and methods.
[BioDigital]

### BioInnovation

Driving financial value through collaboration + global access
* **Sharing expertise and innovation** through our Network Alliance, offering educational exchange,
  knowledge transfer, and proprietary process know-how.
* **Opening doors to innovation** with access to advanced technologies and proprietary reagents.
* **Expanding global reach** by democratizing cell therapy to make lifesaving treatments accessible
  worldwide.

## Network Alliance

The CTMC Network Alliance delivers long-term value by offering members a comprehensive suite of
services, materials, and products to advance cell therapy development. Through specialized training,
educational programs, and readiness assessments, members gain the knowledge to implement cell
therapies effectively and manufacture locally.

[Learn More][16]

## The CTMC Advantage

### Simplifying the Path from Bench to Bedside

Unlike the fragmented traditional CMO model, CTMC provides a fully integrated partnership by uniting
manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, and logistics under one roof. This seamless approach
streamlines the path from preclinical proof-of-concept to clinical data, reducing complexity,
timelines, and cost.

## Maximizing Value.

CTMC’s co-development model accelerates cell therapy programs to clinical proof-of-concept faster
and more efficiently than traditional approaches.

By integrating development, manufacturing, and digital infrastructure into a unified BioSolutions
platform, we reduce execution risk, preserve capital, and create earlier value inflection, giving
investors, researchers, and biotech a clearer, faster path to patients.

## Our 360° Solutions deliver the full suite of capabilities needed to transform groundbreaking
## science into clinical reality – faster, smarter, and all in one place.

[BioSolutions]

### BioSolutions

Comprehensive model to accelerate cell therapy from research to clinical
* **Integrated manufacturing capabilities** — from viral vector production to CAR-T, NK, and TIL
  therapies, all under one roof.
* **Seamless, holistic solutions** — guiding programs from early development through clinical trials
  to commercialization.
* **Comprehensive, bundled expertise** — uniting development, regulatory, clinical, and operational
  support to streamline progress to patients.

[Integrated]

### BioExpertise

Decades of specialized cell therapy experience in the lab and the clinic
* **Collaborative team of scientists, specialists, and technicians** blending deep academic insight
  with proven industrial expertise.
* **Trailblazers in TIL therapy** advancing innovative platforms, technologies, and manufacturing
  processes through our proprietary reagents and methods.
[BioDigital]

### BioInnovation

Driving financial value through collaboration + global access
* **Sharing expertise and innovation** through our Network Alliance, offering educational exchange,
  knowledge transfer, and proprietary process know-how.
* **Opening doors to innovation** with access to advanced technologies and proprietary reagents.
* **Expanding global reach** by democratizing cell therapy to make lifesaving treatments accessible
  worldwide.

## Network Alliance

The CTMC Network Alliance delivers long-term value by offering members a comprehensive suite of
services, materials, and products to advance cell therapy development. Through specialized training,
educational programs, and readiness assessments, members gain the knowledge to implement cell
therapies effectively and manufacture locally.

Unlike the fragmented traditional CMO model, CTMC provides a fully integrated partnership by uniting
manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, and logistics under one roof. This seamless approach
streamlines the path from preclinical proof-of-concept to clinical data, reducing complexity,
timelines, and cost.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad

formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Pioneering a Transformational Approach to Treating Cancer

Iovance Biotherapeutics is pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing
the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient.

[About Iovance Biotherapeutics][41]

## TIL therapy

Tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) are naturally occurring immune cells that fight cancer. TIL are
on constant surveillance to recognize, attack and kill cancer cells. When cancer invades and
prevails, the TIL are unable to perform their intended function. Investigational TIL therapies are
designed to reinvigorate a patient’s TIL to fight cancer. A patient’s naturally occurring TIL are
collected and grown outside the body so they can be administered back to the patient as a one-time
treatment. Once inside the body, **Iovance TIL therapy deploys billions of personalized,
patient-specific TIL to recognize and target diverse cancer cells.**

TIL monotherapy and TIL combination therapies are being investigated in clinical studies in multiple
advanced solid tumor cancers.

 

[Learn more about TIL therapy][42]

[View our scientific publications & presentations][43]

## Now Enrolling

[ Advanced Front-line Melanoma (TILVANCE-301) ][44] [ Advanced Second-line NSCLC (IOV-LUN-202) ][45]
[ Advanced Endometrial Cancer (IOV-END-201) ][46]

## Latest news

[ View All News Releases ][47]

## Clinical platforms

Our T-cell-based immunotherapy technology platforms are potentially applicable to many solid tumor
types. Each platform is focused on leveraging patient-specific cells to recognize and attack diverse
cancer cells that are unique to each patient. Unlike targeted cell therapies that act on shared
antigen targets common to certain tumors, our polyclonal T cells are personalized therapies designed
to target a variety of neoantigens (new proteins generated by tumor mutations) that are unique to
the patient or tumor.

We are currently investigating TIL therapy in clinical trials in multiple advanced solid tumor
cancers. We are also advancing genetically modified TIL therapies as a next-generation approach for
solid tumor cancers.

[View our clinical pipeline][48]

## Iovance Cell Therapy Center (*i*CTC)

Our TIL therapy is manufactured at our state-of-the-art, 136,000–square-foot Cell Therapy Center,
located in Philadelphia, PA, using proprietary good manufacturing practices (GMP).

# 
# Accelerating the future of medicine

At Kytopen, we seek to expand patient access to the next generation of living medicines through
scalable genome engineering platforms by solving cell therapy manufacturing problems at the
discovery stage.

Our non-viral gene delivery platform empowers researchers and developers to accelerate drug
discovery, expedite optimization, and remove barriers to biomanufacturing scaling.

[[Untitled design (88)]][28]
[ICO]

#### KYTOPEN enables efficient cell engineering from discovery through manufacturing

## Technology

Translatable gene delivery across all phases of development

[Flowfect]

Flowfect^{®} technology combines continuous fluid flow with electric fields for high- efficiency
delivery of payloads such as mRNA, DNA, and CRISPR Cas9 RNP to billions of cells in minutes.

The Flowfect^{®} technology continuous process enables unprecedented customization to finetune the
delivery of genome engineering materials to cells and allows predictive scaling from small volume
transfections to the manufacturing scale. 

AUTOMATED
HIGH THROUGHPUT
DISCOVERY

Whether you’re optimizing transfection conditions or discovering a next-generation cell therapy,
Flowfect^{®} technology allows you to investigate and scale with confidence.

**Unlock unprecedented control with multiple parameters to fine-tune delivery for up to 96 samples
in a single experiment within minutes.**

[Kytopen]
[Kytopen]

SCALABLE
CELL ENGINEERING

Save time and lower costs of scaling new therapeutic products by eliminating the gene delivery
bottleneck at discovery.

**Flowfect****® technology enables predictive scaling from small-volume, low-cost optimization
experiments to large-volume manufacturing.**

UNPARALLELED & EFFICIENT
OPTIMIZATION

Combining electrical, mechanical, and chemical forces for gene delivery introduces multiple modes of
influencing transport and interactions to fine-tune engineered cell yields.

Translate optimized parameters between small-volume transfections to large-scale manufacturing with
confidence.

[Kytopen]

## Our platform

Scale with confidence using a single technology

Save time and reduce costs to scaling cell therapies by utilizing the same singular technology.
Explore, discover, and optimize gene delivery before transitioning to large-scale development.

FLOWFECT DISCOVER^{™} PLATFORM

is an automated small-volume liquid-handling platform capable of performing high-throughput
transfections for drug discovery, screening, and process optimization.
* **Retain cell functionality**: Utilizes continuous flow transfection
  
* **Easy to integrate**: Compatible with standard liquid handling consumables such as HSP9655
  96-well plates 
  
* **Unparalleled & efficient optimization**: Capable of running to up 96 separate conditions in a
  single run about 10 minutes for sample volumes ranging from 50-100µL

For research use only. Not for use in clinical or diagnostic procedures

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française

## Life Sciences BC

Life Sciences BC (LSBC) is a not-for-profit sector association dedicated to advancing British
Columbia’s life sciences ecosystem through strategic initiatives at the local, national, and
international levels. We drive economic growth in the province by providing leadership, fostering
investment and partnerships, collaborating with government, and promoting BC’s world-class life
sciences sector.


Our **membership **of over 250 organizations allows us to speak as a unified voice

Our **events** foster connections, relevant conversations, partnerships, and investment–creating a
strong sense of community

Our **programs** fill much-needed training gaps, offering mentorship and skills development–helping
companies to grow

Our work with **government partners** helps to shape provincial and federal strategies

Our **international missions** bring visibility to the sector, attracting international attention,
capital, and talent


## BC is the fastest-growing Life Sciences
## Sector in Canada

**The BC Advantage**
* World-class science
* Skilled talent pool
* Innovative companies growing at scale
* Engaged Government
* Culture: entrepreneurial, collaborative ecosystem
* Geography: Gateway to Asia and the U.S.

# Developing the First and Only Bedside Cell & Gene Therapy delivery system

simple

accessible

TECHNOLOGY

## Making Life-Changing Therapies More
## Accessible Across A Wider Range of Patients

Lupagen is the only medical device and services company dedicated to bedside cell and gene therapy

Our mission is to expand access to innovative therapies by lowering cost and simplifying delivery

Lupagen can help biopharma companies that are exploring alternative delivery solutions to address
current development and market challenges

HOW IT WORKS

## Lupagen’s Bedside Delivery System

Lupagen Xynvivo™ System collects the patient’s peripheral blood cells using standard leukapheresis
process.

Binding to transgene viral vector or nanoparticle product occurs within the Xynvivo™ System and
unbound particles are removed prior to reinfusion to the patient.

This entire process is done in a patient-connected closed loop procedure at the bedside in a few
hours.

PLATFORM BENEFITS

## Extracorporeal Bedside Delivery Platform
## with potential to improve Ex Vivo Cell
## Therapy and In Vivo Gene Therapy

### Ex Vivo Cell Therapy Companies

looking to expand access through a lower cost and simpler production process by migrating to an
in-situ gene therapy approach

### In Vivo Gene Therapy Companies

looking to accelerate their path to the clinic with an alternative route of administration that
mitigates biodistribution challenges: accurate dosing, lower immunogenicity and off-target safety
concerns
* * ###### Potential Benefit

  * ###### In Vivo
  
  ### Production Cost Savings

## Lupagen’s Bedside Delivery System

Lupagen Xynvivo™ System collects the patient’s peripheral blood cells using standard leukapheresis
process.

Binding to transgene viral vector or nanoparticle product occurs within the Xynvivo™ System and
unbound particles are removed prior to reinfusion to the patient.

This entire process is done in a patient-connected closed loop procedure at the bedside in a few
hours.

## 事業内容
## BUSINESS

### 特定細胞加工物製造業

再生医療等安全性確保法に基づく特定細胞加工物の製造を受託します。

[詳しく見る][85]

### CDMO事業

医薬品医療機器等法（薬機法）に基づく再生医療等製品・治験製品の工程開発から製造受託までトータルサポー
トで承ります。

[詳しく見る][86]

### バリューチェーン事業

再生医療の細胞加工に携わるすべてのお客様の業務負荷を軽減するためのソリューションを提供し、円滑な再生
医療の実施を支援いたします。

[詳しく見る][87]

### 自己がん組織バンク

将来のがん治療に備えて、がんの手術などで摘出した患者さんのがん組織を無償でお預かりします。

[詳しく見る][88]

### 免疫細胞治療とは

免疫細胞治療は、自分の免疫細胞を使ってがんを攻撃する治療法です。メディネットは創業以来、免疫細胞治療
の技術開発に取り組んでいます。

[詳しく見る][89]

医薬品・医療機器・再生医療等製品の実用化を目指している
個人を含めたベンチャー、アカデミア等をご支援致します。

## 医療系ベンチャー・
## トータルサポート事業について

医療系ベンチャー・トータルサポート事業とは、実用化に向けた課題を抱えた医療系ベンチャー企業、アカデミ
ア等と、その解決のためのアドバイスを行う専門家（サポーター※）をマッチングし、研究開発の段階から、臨
床現場での実用・保険適用、グローバル市場への進出・普及までを総合的・俯瞰的に見据えた上で、各段階に応
じたきめ細かな相談・支援を行う事業です。
※サポーターとは、法規制対応、マーケティング、事業計画、資金調達、経営戦略、知財戦略、国際展開等の各
分野の専門家です。

当サイトは、厚生労働省委託「医療系ベンチャー・トータルサポート事業」の一環として、厚生労働省医政局経
済課の指示に基づき、受託者である株式会社三菱総合研究所が運営しております。

テルモ株式会社にて37年間、医療機器と再生医療等製品の製品開発や事業遂行に従事。基礎から承認取得までの
研究開発に加えて、製品化後の生産、販売の事業組織マネジメントまで幅広く経験してきた。医療機器では、体
外循環型、植込み型、輸血用などの製品開発を、また、再生医療等製品では、心不全治療用細胞シートの製品化
を行った。これらの開発において、大学や研究機関との共同開発、企業間の連携、厚生労働省やPMDAとの協議、
国の科学技術事業への参加、さらに、関連する業界団体の活動に参加しており、さまざまな開発段階に対して、
現場目線での具体的な助言を行うことができる。
2021年にテルモを定年退職して、現職にてコンサルティングを実施している。

タル（現

ディシン、（株）Luxonus社外取締役、京都大学医学研究科「医学領域」産学連携推進機構・産学連携フェロー

2017年から米国ボストン在住。以降，投資家，スタートアップ，政府系アクセラレーターなど複数の視点・立場
から，一貫してボストンのスタートアップエコシステムに関わる。
ダイキン工業にて，NAISTとの包括連携を立ち上げ，大学内に実施拠点を開設し，1億円のプロジェクトをリード
，葉緑体形質転換レタスによるPlant-made
Pharmaceuticalの研究を3研究科の教授と実行，7名を雇用，16件の特許出願した。研究職から新規事業へ転進後
，始動を含む多くのビジネスモデルコンペに選抜され，イスラエルのヤングリーダーに選ばれ国費派遣された。
そのイントレプレナーシップを買われ，米国東海岸，イスラエル，カナダのスタートアップ調査に従事するため
Daikin
U.S.に駐在。ボストンオフィスを開設し，スタートアップとのPoC，共同研究，11大学との連携を立ち上げた。
デジタルヘルスのスタートアップでは，日米間の医療データの取扱いの違いから，医療機器，電子 当サイトの改良、サービス案内、閲覧状況分析などに利用するため、

メディソは、医療系ベンチャー・トータルサポート事業の総合ポータルサイトです。
医薬品・医療機器・再生医療等製品の実用化を目指している
個人を含めたベンチャー、アカデミア等をご支援致します。

## 医療系ベンチャー・
## トータルサポート事業について

医療系ベンチャー・トータルサポート事業とは、実用化に向けた課題を抱えた医療系ベンチャー企業、アカデミ
ア等と、その解決のためのアドバイスを行う専門家（サポーター※）をマッチングし、研究開発の段階から、臨
床現場での実用・保険適用、グローバル市場への進出・普及までを総合的・俯瞰的に見据えた上で、各段階に応
じたきめ細かな相談・支援を行う事業です。
※サポーターとは、法規制対応、マーケティング、事業計画、資金調達、経営戦略、知財戦略、国際展開等の各
分野の専門家です。

当サイトは、厚生労働省委託「医療系ベンチャー・トータルサポート事業」の一環として、厚生労働省医政局経
済課の指示に基づき、受託者である株式会社三菱総合研究所が運営しております。

テルモ株式会社にて37年間、医療機器と再生医療等製品の製品開発や事業遂行に従事。基礎から承認取得までの
研究開発に加えて、製品化後の生産、販売の事業組織マネジメントまで幅広く経験してきた。医療機器では、体
外循環型、植込み型、輸血用などの製品開発を、また、再生医療等製品では、心不全治療用細胞シートの製品化

2017年から米国ボストン在住。以降，投資家，スタートアップ，政府系アクセラレーターなど複数の視点・立場
から，一貫してボストンのスタートアップエコシステムに関わる。
ダイキン工業にて，NAISTとの包括連携を立ち上げ，大学内に実施拠点を開設し，1億円のプロジェクトをリード
，葉緑体形質転換レタスによるPlant-made
Pharmaceuticalの研究を3研究科の教授と実行，7名を雇用，16件の特許出願した。研究職から新規事業へ転進後
，始動を含む多くのビジネスモデルコンペに選抜され，イスラエルのヤングリーダーに選ばれ国費派遣された。
そのイントレプレナーシップを買われ，米国東海岸，イスラエル，カナダのスタートアップ調査に従事するため
Daikin
U.S.に駐在。ボストンオフィスを開設し，スタートアップとのPoC，共同研究，11大学との連携を立ち上げた。
デジタルヘルスのスタートアップでは，日米間の医療データの取扱いの違いから，医療機器，電子カルテ，Real
World Evidenceのクライアントとの連携を確立した。 CIC本社Japan
Deskでは，JETROと連携し，日本の創薬・医療機器スタートアップの米国進出を支援するアクセラレーションプ
ログラムをデザイン・運営した。
現在は，VCのポートフォリオ企業ハンズオン支援と顧客開発，日本、米国のearly-stageの創薬スタートアップ
の日米国進出，資金調達を支援している。遊び情報も含んだ最新のボストンの情報をSNSで配信中。バイオ・ラ
イフサイエンス分野の日本語話者のコミュニティBoston Biotech Hubを運営。

Corp.（米国）にて医療機器・医薬品・食品分野のFDA登録や、規制調査業務のアシスタントとして従事。多数の
海外企業のプロジェクトに携わり、実務に基づくFDA対応の知見を蓄積した。その後、グロービッツ・ジャパン
へ転籍し、東京事務所にてプロジェクトコーディネーターとして、米国進出を目指す企業に対し、課題に応じた
個別支援プランの企画・提案を担当。米国本社コンサルタントとクライアントの調整を含め、プロジェクト全体
のコーディネーションを担っている。米国本社のFDAコンサルタントを含む専門家チームと連携することで、高
い精度と実効性を備えた支援が可能。また、FDA査察の経験者
として査察への立ち合いも行い、各専門家と協力し、通訳サポート、品質マネジメントシステム（QMSR）構築、
Form 483対応、CAPA策定支援など、実践的支援を提供している。

######  COLLAGEN BIO-STIMULATOR 

## FillMED Juvelook®

#### Soft Tissue Injectable Implant for Collagen Induction

Discover Protocols
[Order Products ][40]

JUVELOOK is a hybrid injectable designed to improve skin quality through a gradual and natural
process. It combines non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid with Poly-D, L-lactic acid (PDLLA), a
biocompatible polymer used in aesthetic medicine. This dual composition is associated with processes
related to collagen and elastin support in the skin, while maintaining a natural-looking result
without altering facial volumes.

[pb serum smartker medstrategija.png]
[medstrategija.com brands.008.jpeg]

######  ENZYMATIC SKIN QUALITY SYSTEM 

## pbserum Smartker®

#### Topical Professional System for Skin Renewal and Skin Quality Improvement

[Discover Protocols ][41]
[Order Products ][42]

SMARTKER is an enzymatic skin quality system designed to improve the appearance of the skin through
a controlled and physiological renewal process. It is based on recombinant keratinase PB333,
combined with targeted active ingredients adapted to different skin needs. 

[1920x1080_AF-RANGE-RGB-FM-0422-WEB.jpg]

######  HA DERMAL FILLERS 

## FillMED Art Filler®

#### Dermal Fillers for Heute Sculpting and Regeneration

[Discover Protocols ][43]
[Order Products ][44]

Based on the innovative Tri-Hyal® Technology, ART FILLER® products are designed to deliver
mechanical correction together with tissue induction, targeting key cellular mechanisms involved in
skin ageing. The range consists of five injectable products — Fine Lines, Universal, Lips Soft,
Lips, and Volume — each formulated with specific rheological properties to address distinct clinical
indications and for treating the full spectrum of aesthetic concerns, from fine superficial wrinkles
to deep volume loss and facial contour restoration.

NCTF 135 HA by Laboratoire FILLMED has been trusted worldwide for over 45 years as the unique
mesotherapy formula and the golden standard for improving skin quality. Today, it remains an
exceptional solution on the market — used not only as a stand-alone treatment, but also increasingly
in combination with other aesthetic protocols and even scar treatments to achieve enhanced results.

leaving the epidermis largely intact. The result is improved skin texture, firmness, and elasticity,
with minimal downtime and high patient tolerability.

# NextCell – en del av stamcells­revolutionen

Stamceller väntas revolutionera behandlingen av svåra och obotbara sjukdomar. NextCell utvecklar
banbrytande stamcellsterapier för behandling av främst autoimmuna och inflammatoriska sjukdomar.
Längst har vi kommit med ProTrans för behandling av typ 1-diabetes.

## Vår produktportfölj

NextCell utvecklar avancerade stamcellsterapier med ett initialt fokus på behandling av typ
1-diabetes. Huvudkandidaten ProTrans bygger på NextCells patenterade selektionsalgoritm. NextCell
driver även Cellaviva – Skandinaviens största [stamcellsbank][61].
[Läs mer][62]

## Om NextCell

NextCell är ett svenskt bioteknikföretag som driver tre affärsområden – [Cellaviva][63], ProTrans
och [QVance][64] – där den gemensamma kärnan är cellterapier och utveckling av avancerade
terapiläkemedel (ATMPs).

# NextCell – en del av stamcells­revolutionen

Stamceller väntas revolutionera behandlingen av svåra och obotbara sjukdomar. NextCell utvecklar
banbrytande stamcellsterapier för behandling av främst autoimmuna och inflammatoriska sjukdomar.
Längst har vi kommit med ProTrans för behandling av typ 1-diabetes.

## Vår produktportfölj

NextCell utvecklar avancerade stamcellsterapier med ett initialt fokus på behandling av typ
1-diabetes. Huvudkandidaten ProTrans bygger på NextCells patenterade selektionsalgoritm. NextCell
driver även Cellaviva – Skandinaviens största [stamcellsbank][61].
[Läs mer][62]

## Om NextCell

NextCell är ett svenskt bioteknikföretag som driver tre affärsområden – [Cellaviva][63], ProTrans
och [QVance][64] – där den gemensamma kärnan är cellterapier och utveckling av avancerade
terapiläkemedel (ATMPs).
[Sample in a lab is being examined][Läs mer][65]

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &

Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

Every therapy we produce begins in our cGMP-certified facility in Kuala Lumpur and meets
international manufacturing standards before it reaches a patient. From regenerative stem cells for
tissue repair to immunotherapies engineered to target cancer, we offer a full spectrum of cellular
medicine — each backed by clinical research protocols and rigorous quality testing.

repair, reduce inflammation and promote regeneration in conditions including osteoarthritis, chronic
wounds, hair loss and age-related degeneration.

NK Cell Therapy

### Natural Killer Cell Therapy

Expanded and activated NK cells designed to strengthen the body's immune response against cancerous
and virally infected cells. Applied in supportive immunotherapy for select cancers, HIV and
hepatitis B.

### Exosome Therapy

Cell-derived extracellular vesicles that promote cellular communication and tissue regeneration.

need for live cell transplantation.

T-cells are engineered to identify and attack specific cancer cells. Relevant for certain blood
cancers including leukaemia, lymphoma and multiple myeloma.

healing, stimulate hair growth and support skin regeneration. Available for aesthetic and
regenerative applications.

# Announcing the Relocation of our West Coast Headquarters to Ohio

Resilience announces the relocation of its corporate headquarters from San Diego, California to Blue
Ash, Ohio, a northern suburb of Cincinnati, and expansion of its sterile manufacturing
capabilities. 

[Read the Press Release][61]
[Resilience key art graphic]

## Nothing in this industry ever stays the same. So we've evolved too.

We've expanded our strengths while keeping quality, speed, and sustainability front and center to
build a more resilient tomorrow, today. Resilience is bringing together brilliant minds in science
and engineering with access to advanced technologies and right-first-time performance at scale.

## Facilities

Resilience is North America based, with facilities across the continental US and Canada. Our
regulatory expertise spans across global markets and serves customers in the EU, Asia, the Middle
East, and North America.

[ See our sites [resi-arrow-white] ][62]

## Custom solutions to fit your needs

We were founded with a straightforward yet bold purpose: to broaden access to complex medicines and
to protect biopharmaceutical supply chains against disruption. At the heart of our approach is a
network of high-tech, end-to-end drug substance and drug product manufacturing solutions that can
help ensure the medicines of today and tomorrow can be made quickly, safely, sustainably, and at
scale.

Our dedication to quality drives everything we do. Our unwavering commitment comes to life

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Pioneering the Development of Automated Technologies for Cell-Based Therapeutics and
## Bioprocessing

*For more than two decades ThermoGenesis has developed and commercialized novel cell processing
systems and devices providing global researchers, biomanufacturing organizations and clinicians with
highly efficient cell processing devices which helped them to deliver better outcomes in various
applications in the cell and gene therapy field.*

**Advancing Cell and Gene Therapies From Lab to Clinic**

With decades of experience, we deliver innovative solutions that support every stage of the cell
therapy workflow — from biobanking and point-of-care processing to scalable, clinical-grade
manufacturing. Explore how our technologies are helping researchers, clinicians, and institutions
move science forward with confidence.

**Clinical BioBanking**

**With over 20 years of providing cord blood to banks hospitals, researchers and stem clinicians
with systems designed to handle stem cells with the highest level of precision, safety, and
confidence.**

[Learn More][20]

**Cellular Processing**

**The first step in the process is often the most important. That’s why we have created
closed-system novel and innovative technologies aimed at advancing cell therapies to the clinic.**

[Learn More][21]

**Products for Cellular Processing and Storage**

We offer closed automated solutions for manual steps in the cell manufacturing process. Our flexible
automated modules provide performance gains in purifying mononuclear cells, washing contaminants
from cell fractions, cell selection, and storage while significantly shortening processing times.

Explore ThermoGenesis Technology

What data sources does MedPath Trial use?

agencies including FDA, EMA, NMPA, TGA, and Health Canada. All data is updated daily.
How does the AI research assistant work?
Our AI analyzes trial protocols, regulatory documents, and scientific literature to provide
insights. All AI-generated content includes source citations for verification.
Is the data on MedPath Trial free to access?

research, data export, and priority support.
How often is the data updated?
Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

### Chuyên gia giàu kinh nghiệm

Vinmec quy tụ đội ngũ chuyên gia, bác sĩ, dược sĩ và điều dưỡng có trình độ chuyên môn cao, tay nghề
giỏi, tận tâm và chuyên nghiệp. Luôn đặt người bệnh làm trung tâm, Vinmec cam kết đem đến dịch vụ
chăm sóc sức khỏe tốt cho khách hàng.
[Chất lượng quốc tế]

### Chất lượng quốc tế

Hệ thống Y tế Vinmec được quản lý và vận hành dưới sự giám sát của những nhà quản lý y tế giàu kinh
nghiệm, cùng với sự hỗ trợ của phương tiện kỹ thuật hiện đại, nhằm đảm bảo cung cấp dịch vụ chăm sóc
sức khỏe toàn diện và hiệu quả.
[Công nghệ tiên tiến]

### Công nghệ tiên tiến

Vinmec cung cấp cơ sở chất lượng và dịch vụ 5 sao bằng cách sử dụng các công nghệ tiên tiến được
quản lý bởi các bác sĩ lâm sàng lành nghề để đảm bảo dịch vụ chăm sóc sức khỏe toàn diện và hiệu quả
cao
[Nghiên cứu & Đổi mới]

### Nghiên cứu & Đổi mới

Vinmec liên tục thúc đẩy y học hàn lâm dựa trên nghiên cứu có phương pháp và sự phát triển y tế được
chia sẻ từ quan hệ đối tác toàn cầu với các hệ thống chăm sóc sức khỏe trên thế giới nhằm cung cấp
các phương pháp điều trị mang tính cách mạng và sáng tạo cho tiêu chuẩn chăm sóc bệnh nhân.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins

* Biobetters and Novel biologics

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

# Convening the Cell and Gene Therapy Community

ARM unites the cell and gene therapy ecosystem to modernize healthcare systems, overcome obstacles
to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

[ Join ARM ][119]
[Hero Illustration] [Mobile Hero Illustration]

## Uniting Innovators in Cell and Gene Therapy

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

[ Learn More About ARM ][120]
[Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics]

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

We support our members in advancing living medicines that target the root causes of
disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a
wide range of conditions.

[Data that drives the sector forward]

### Data that drives the sector forward

Our data and reports track the global pipeline, clinical trials, regulatory shifts, and funding
trends, giving the CGT community and our stakeholders the insight needed to make informed, strategic
decisions.

## ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids
## Access to Care Act

These policies, which became law with President Trump’s signature, represent hope for the rare
disease community and will meaningfully improve access to life-changing and life-saving treatments.

# Convening the Cell and Gene Therapy Community

ARM unites the cell and gene therapy ecosystem to modernize healthcare systems, overcome obstacles
to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

[ Join ARM ][119]
[Hero Illustration] [Mobile Hero Illustration]

## Uniting Innovators in Cell and Gene Therapy

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

[ Learn More About ARM ][120]
[Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics]

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

We support our members in advancing living medicines that target the root causes of
disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a
wide range of conditions.

[Data that drives the sector forward]

### Data that drives the sector forward

Our data and reports track the global pipeline, clinical trials, regulatory shifts, and funding
trends, giving the CGT community and our stakeholders the insight needed to make informed, strategic
decisions.

## ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids
## Access to Care Act

These policies, which became law with President Trump’s signature, represent hope for the rare
disease community and will meaningfully improve access to life-changing and life-saving treatments.

We applaud Congress for passing ARM’s top two legislative priorities and are grateful to our partner
organizations whose collaboration and advocacy were crucial in securing the necessary support.

[ Read ARM's Statement ][121]

medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.
