### A Trusted Pharmaceutical Company manufacturing Bulk Drug API

[about]

APMIDA Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. manufacturing Bulk Drug API derived from various chemicals which
have a growing demand globally. The company is linked with developed pieces of equipment of the
technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of
the art manufacturing is Drug licensed and GMP and ISO certifications. Along with this, our
production place has the following amenities:
* #### We have vast and spacious warehouse in excise free zones to do the other activities of the
  #### manufacturing of the drugs.
* #### Quality control Lab and Analytical Testing along with R&D Manufacturing facilities
* #### State Drug licenses
* #### FDA Registered

### We are Helping to Advance Health with Clinical Trials for Medicine.

APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company that develops, manufactures, and
sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.

# Groundbreaking innovations are reshaping the world of medicine

Caring Cross aims to lower the cost and change how advanced therapies are made and delivered to
patients that need them. We are developing therapies to treat Leukemia, Lymphoma, HIV and Sickle
Cell Disease.

[
Learn More
][35]
Slide 2

# Breakthroughs in medicine have resulted in new life-saving advanced therapies

We work directly with hospitals to manufacture the products at the place of care so that all needing
these transformative therapies are able to access them in an affordable manner.

[
Learn More
][36]
Slide 3

# We collaborate with a diverse network of academic institutions and organizations

Through these partnerships, we leverage complementary expertise, share resources, and accelerate the
translation of research discoveries into clinical applications.

[
Learn More
][37]

#### Here’s what drives us:

## 37 Million

people living with HIV/AIDS worldwide (1.8 million children).

## 18 Million

new cancer cases in 2018 with 9.5 million deaths worldwide.

## $350,000+

Is the cost of a CAR-T cell therapy for Lymphoma, not including hospital costs.

Potentially life-saving advanced therapies are available, but they are neither affordable nor
accessible to millions of patients.

#### Access to life-saving advanced therapies should be a human right for all in need, not just for
#### the privileged few.

#### Here’s how we do it:

[puzzle pieces]

### Safe, effective and affordable advanced therapies.

We develop improved advanced therapies and innovative manufacturing processes to lower their cost.

[Collaboration - icon]

### Strategic collaboration.

We partner with a diverse array of stakeholders that support our vision of affordable access to
advanced therapies worldwide.

[people]

### Enabling access.

We support hospitals and health systems to manufacture advanced therapy products close to where
patients come for care, improving access.

[background]

## Every person should be able to access affordable advanced medicines.

#### Here’s how you can help:

### [Partner with us.][38]

Help us develop improved advanced therapies and increase their affordability and access for the
patients that need them.

### [Spread the word.][39]

Follow and share our content on your social media channels.

## Stem cell therapy that targets the cause, not just the symptoms.

Osteoarthritis and degenerative disc disease together affect more than 600 million people worldwide.
Current standard of care — NSAIDs, steroids, joint replacement — manages symptoms but doesn't
address the underlying tissue degeneration.

Our autologous ChondroStem™ and allogeneic modalities — advanced through Oracle's manufacturing
intelligence — deliver live, GMP-grade stem cells engineered to regenerate damaged cartilage and
disc tissue. Published clinical data demonstrate significant, sustained reductions in pain and
improvements in function.

## GMP Manufacturing from First-in-Human Clinical Trials to Commercial Supply

Our experience in GMP manufacturing of complex and sophisticated cell-based therapies with global
reach can support your program. We offer licensed GMP manufacturing for autologous and allogeneic
cell therapy products throughout the development pipeline, from translational first-in-human
clinical studies to late-phase trials and commercial supply.

Our two decades of experience span autologous and allogeneic therapies across a wide range of cell
types, including chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cells, mesenchymal stromal cells,
tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs), and human pluripotent stem cells and their derivatives.

[Learn more about Contract Manufacturing][62]

## Seamless and Scalable Program Onboarding

Our technology transfer framework enables efficient onboarding of complex cell therapy programs into
our GMP facility. We apply a phase-appropriate, risk-based approach across six gated stages from
technical feasibility assessment, knowledge capture, to process implementation, ensuring operational
continuity and reducing transition risk.

With over ten (10) successful technology transfers in the last 4 years (including commercial CAR-T
programs), our team is adept at scaling diverse modalities under strict regulatory conditions.

[Learn more about Technology Transfer][63]

## End-to-End Cold Chain Management

Cell Therapies provides validated cryopreservation of clinical materials, including apheresis
collections, in-process intermediates, and final products, using vapor-phase liquid nitrogen
systems. Our GMP-compliant workflows include labeling, storage, and full-chain-of-custody
documentation ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements for both clinical and commercial
programs.

Our logistics partnerships and in-house support enable reliable, time-critical delivery across
Australia, the Asia-Pacific region, and global clinical trial networks.

hospitals and clinical sites across Australia, Asia-Pacific, and globally. We also support
direct-to-patient delivery models for time-sensitive autologous therapies.

# Where Cell Therapy Innovation Meets Acceleration

CTMC offers fully integrated 360° Solutions combined with a patient-adjacent manufacturing model
with The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center.

We are so much more than a CDMO.

## Minimizing Risk.
## Accelerating Time to Clinic.
## Maximizing Value.

CTMC’s co-development model accelerates cell therapy programs to clinical proof-of-concept faster
and more efficiently than traditional approaches.

By integrating development, manufacturing, and digital infrastructure into a unified BioSolutions
platform, we reduce execution risk, preserve capital, and create earlier value inflection, giving
investors, researchers, and biotech a clearer, faster path to patients.

## Our 360° Solutions deliver the full suite of capabilities needed to transform groundbreaking
## science into clinical reality – faster, smarter, and all in one place.

[BioSolutions]

### BioSolutions

Comprehensive model to accelerate cell therapy from research to clinical
* **Integrated manufacturing capabilities** — from viral vector production to CAR-T, NK, and TIL
  therapies, all under one roof.
* **Seamless, holistic solutions** — guiding programs from early development through clinical trials
  to commercialization.
* **Comprehensive, bundled expertise** — uniting development, regulatory, clinical, and operational
  support to streamline progress to patients.

[Integrated]

### BioExpertise

Decades of specialized cell therapy experience in the lab and the clinic
* **Collaborative team of scientists, specialists, and technicians** blending deep academic insight
  with proven industrial expertise.
* **Trailblazers in TIL therapy** advancing innovative platforms, technologies, and manufacturing
  processes through our proprietary reagents and methods.
[BioDigital]

### BioInnovation

Driving financial value through collaboration + global access
* **Sharing expertise and innovation** through our Network Alliance, offering educational exchange,
  knowledge transfer, and proprietary process know-how.
* **Opening doors to innovation** with access to advanced technologies and proprietary reagents.
* **Expanding global reach** by democratizing cell therapy to make lifesaving treatments accessible
  worldwide.

## Network Alliance

The CTMC Network Alliance delivers long-term value by offering members a comprehensive suite of
services, materials, and products to advance cell therapy development. Through specialized training,
educational programs, and readiness assessments, members gain the knowledge to implement cell
therapies effectively and manufacture locally.

[Learn More][16]

## The CTMC Advantage

### Simplifying the Path from Bench to Bedside

Unlike the fragmented traditional CMO model, CTMC provides a fully integrated partnership by uniting
manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, and logistics under one roof. This seamless approach
streamlines the path from preclinical proof-of-concept to clinical data, reducing complexity,
timelines, and cost.

[Learn More][17]

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

continuously reconciled record.

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place
* Target markets to reach
* Sales channels to sell through
* Requirements for the right partner

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Pioneering a Transformational Approach to Treating Cancer

Iovance Biotherapeutics is pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing
the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient.

[About Iovance Biotherapeutics][41]

## TIL therapy

Tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) are naturally occurring immune cells that fight cancer. TIL are
on constant surveillance to recognize, attack and kill cancer cells. When cancer invades and
prevails, the TIL are unable to perform their intended function. Investigational TIL therapies are
designed to reinvigorate a patient’s TIL to fight cancer. A patient’s naturally occurring TIL are
collected and grown outside the body so they can be administered back to the patient as a one-time
treatment. Once inside the body, **Iovance TIL therapy deploys billions of personalized,
patient-specific TIL to recognize and target diverse cancer cells.**

TIL monotherapy and TIL combination therapies are being investigated in clinical studies in multiple
advanced solid tumor cancers.

 

[Learn more about TIL therapy][42]

[View our scientific publications & presentations][43]

## Now Enrolling

[ Advanced Front-line Melanoma (TILVANCE-301) ][44] [ Advanced Second-line NSCLC (IOV-LUN-202) ][45]
[ Advanced Endometrial Cancer (IOV-END-201) ][46]

## Latest news

[ View All News Releases ][47]

## Clinical platforms

Our T-cell-based immunotherapy technology platforms are potentially applicable to many solid tumor
types. Each platform is focused on leveraging patient-specific cells to recognize and attack diverse
cancer cells that are unique to each patient. Unlike targeted cell therapies that act on shared
antigen targets common to certain tumors, our polyclonal T cells are personalized therapies designed
to target a variety of neoantigens (new proteins generated by tumor mutations) that are unique to
the patient or tumor.

We are currently investigating TIL therapy in clinical trials in multiple advanced solid tumor
cancers. We are also advancing genetically modified TIL therapies as a next-generation approach for
solid tumor cancers.

[View our clinical pipeline][48]

## Iovance Cell Therapy Center (*i*CTC)

Our TIL therapy is manufactured at our state-of-the-art, 136,000–square-foot Cell Therapy Center,
located in Philadelphia, PA, using proprietary good manufacturing practices (GMP).

[Learn more about the *i*CTC][49]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

## Life Sciences BC

Life Sciences BC (LSBC) is a not-for-profit sector association dedicated to advancing British
Columbia’s life sciences ecosystem through strategic initiatives at the local, national, and
international levels. We drive economic growth in the province by providing leadership, fostering
investment and partnerships, collaborating with government, and promoting BC’s world-class life
sciences sector.


Our **membership **of over 250 organizations allows us to speak as a unified voice

Our **events** foster connections, relevant conversations, partnerships, and investment–creating a
strong sense of community

Our **programs** fill much-needed training gaps, offering mentorship and skills development–helping
companies to grow

Our work with **government partners** helps to shape provincial and federal strategies

Our **international missions** bring visibility to the sector, attracting international attention,
capital, and talent

# Developing the First and Only Bedside Cell & Gene Therapy delivery system

simple
safe
accessible

TECHNOLOGY

## Making Life-Changing Therapies More
## Accessible Across A Wider Range of Patients

Lupagen is the only medical device and services company dedicated to bedside cell and gene therapy

Our mission is to expand access to innovative therapies by lowering cost and simplifying delivery

Lupagen can help biopharma companies that are exploring alternative delivery solutions to address
current development and market challenges

HOW IT WORKS

## Lupagen’s Bedside Delivery System

Lupagen Xynvivo™ System collects the patient’s peripheral blood cells using standard leukapheresis
process.

Binding to transgene viral vector or nanoparticle product occurs within the Xynvivo™ System and
unbound particles are removed prior to reinfusion to the patient.

This entire process is done in a patient-connected closed loop procedure at the bedside in a few
hours.

PLATFORM BENEFITS

## Extracorporeal Bedside Delivery Platform
## with potential to improve Ex Vivo Cell
## Therapy and In Vivo Gene Therapy

### Ex Vivo Cell Therapy Companies

looking to expand access through a lower cost and simpler production process by migrating to an
in-situ gene therapy approach

### In Vivo Gene Therapy Companies

looking to accelerate their path to the clinic with an alternative route of administration that
mitigates biodistribution challenges: accurate dosing, lower immunogenicity and off-target safety
concerns

  Can convert complex and expensive ex vivo manufacturing processes to a simple bedside procedure
  
  ### Better Patient Experience
  
  Simple outpatient procedure providing affordable treatment and expanded patient access
  
  ### Enables Repeat Dosing
  
  Dosing flexibility due to simple, safe, and cost effective delivery platform
  
  ### Safer, More Effective Gene Therapy
  
  Controlled dosing can potentially mitigate organ toxicity, immunogenicity and off-target gene
  insertion

SERVICES

## Lupagen is the only company dedicated to providing Extracorporeal Cell and Gene Therapy Delivery
## Technologies to the Biopharma industry

Cell and Gene Therapy is changing rapidly and becoming increasingly competitive as Biopharma
companies pursue similar targets and diseases.

Lupagen’s extracorporeal delivery experts can collaborate with you to create and expand the value of
your core cell and gene therapy program with a differentiated and accelerated path to the clinic.

Can your costly cell therapy benefit from extracorporeal delivery to address market access and
competitive challenges?

How can your program prepare for challenges related to dosing, delivery and clinical effectiveness?

Does your program need assistance to surmount regulatory hurdles that may delay time to clinical and
commercial stages?

### Lupagen will be there every step of the way as your full-service delivery device partner from
### early stage preclinical through commercial.

* Device related regulatory and IRB support

* Product kit supply and delivery to treatment centers

### 特定細胞加工物製造業

医薬品医療機器等法（薬機法）に基づく再生医療等製品・治験製品の工程開発から製造受託までトータルサポー
トで承ります。

[詳しく見る][86]

### バリューチェーン事業

再生医療の細胞加工に携わるすべてのお客様の業務負荷を軽減するためのソリューションを提供し、円滑な再生
医療の実施を支援いたします。

[詳しく見る][87]

### 自己がん組織バンク

将来のがん治療に備えて、がんの手術などで摘出した患者さんのがん組織を無償でお預かりします。

[詳しく見る][88]

### 免疫細胞治療とは

免疫細胞治療は、自分の免疫細胞を使ってがんを攻撃する治療法です。メディネットは創業以来、免疫細胞治療
の技術開発に取り組んでいます。

## MEDISOとはメディソ

メディソは、医療系ベンチャー・トータルサポート事業の総合ポータルサイトです。
医薬品・医療機器・再生医療等製品の実用化を目指している
個人を含めたベンチャー、アカデミア等をご支援致します。
[ベンチャートータルサポート事業について][37]

## 医療系ベンチャー・
## トータルサポート事業について

医療系ベンチャー・トータルサポート事業とは、実用化に向けた課題を抱えた医療系ベンチャー企業、アカデミ
ア等と、その解決のためのアドバイスを行う専門家（サポーター※）をマッチングし、研究開発の段階から、臨
床現場での実用・保険適用、グローバル市場への進出・普及までを総合的・俯瞰的に見据えた上で、各段階に応
じたきめ細かな相談・支援を行う事業です。
※サポーターとは、法規制対応、マーケティング、事業計画、資金調達、経営戦略、知財戦略、国際展開等の各
分野の専門家です。

当サイトは、厚生労働省委託「医療系ベンチャー・トータルサポート事業」の一環として、厚生労働省医政局経
済課の指示に基づき、受託者である株式会社三菱総合研究所が運営しております。

[×][38]

### 支援対象

薬機法の対象となる医薬品・医療機器・再生医療等製品、
新たな創薬技術や医療用マテリアル等の実用化を目指している
個人を含めたベンチャー、アカデミア等。

### 支援内容

薬機法の対象となる医薬品・医療機器・再生医療等製品の
実用化をご支援致します。
例）事業計画、資金調達、法規制対応等
* **●支援方法：**オンライン会議システム、メール、対面にてご支援致します。
* **●支  援  元：**サポーター（研究開発・薬事等の専門家）や厚生労働省を含めた関係機関と連携してご支
  援致します。
* **●備 考：**ご相談・支援は無料です。

## **サポーター**の紹介

登録されている主なサポーターを
紹介します（随時更新予定）。

### 鮫島 正Tadashi Sameshima

セルスデック 代表

#### 領域
* 医療機器
* 再生医療等製品

#### 分野
* 法規制対応
* マーケティング
* 事業計画
* 事業実施体制

テルモ株式会社にて37年間、医療機器と再生医療等製品の製品開発や事業遂行に従事。基礎から承認取得までの
研究開発に加えて、製品化後の生産、販売の事業組織マネジメントまで幅広く経験してきた。医療機器では、体
外循環型、植込み型、輸血用などの製品開発を、また、再生医療等製品では、心不全治療用細胞シートの製品化
を行った。これらの開発において、大学や研究機関との共同開発、企業間の連携、厚生労働省やPMDAとの協議、
国の科学技術事業への参加、さらに、関連する業界団体の活動に参加しており、さまざまな開発段階に対して、
現場目線での具体的な助言を行うことができる。
2021年にテルモを定年退職して、現職にてコンサルティングを実施している。


### 長谷川 宏之Hiroyuki Hasegawa

三菱ＵＦＪキャピタル株式会社

#### 領域
* 医薬品
* 医療機器
* 再生医療等製品

#### 分野
* 法規制対応
* マーケティング
* 事業計画
* 資金調達
* 事業実施体制

北海道大学薬学研究科修士課程修了。1994年、第一製薬株式会社（現
第一三共株式会社）に入社し市販後調査部門に配属し感染症領域、癌領域を担当。2004年、株式会社UFJキャピ
タル（現
三菱UFJキャピタル株式会社）に入社しアナリストを経て、キャピタリストに従事。第一三共との共同でオープ
ンイノベーション・ファンド（OiDEファンド）を活用したアカデミア発研究成果をもとに創薬基盤技術に育成す
る試みを2013年より展開（2023年終了）。2017年の１号ファンド以降、「三菱UFJライフサイエンス4号ファンド
」（200億円）を含め計500億円を活用した投資活動を推進。現在、カムイファーマ(株)、（株）ガイアバイオメ
ディシン、（株）Luxonus社外取締役、京都大学医学研究科「医学領域」産学連携推進機構・産学連携フェロー
、JST START代表事業プロモーター。


### 加藤 愛子Aiko Kato Sullenberger

RykoTECH 社長

#### 領域
* 医薬品
* 医療機器
* 再生医療等製品

#### 分野
* マーケティング
* 事業計画
* 資金調達
* 事業実施体制

2017年から米国ボストン在住。以降，投資家，スタートアップ，政府系アクセラレーターなど複数の視点・立場
から，一貫してボストンのスタートアップエコシステムに関わる。
ダイキン工業にて，NAISTとの包括連携を立ち上げ，大学内に実施拠点を開設し，1億円のプロジェクトをリード
，葉緑体形質転換レタスによるPlant-made
Pharmaceuticalの研究を3研究科の教授と実行，7名を雇用，16件の特許出願した。研究職から新規事業へ転進後
，始動を含む多くのビジネスモデルコンペに選抜され，イスラエルのヤングリーダーに選ばれ国費派遣された。
そのイントレプレナーシップを買われ，米国東海岸，イスラエル，カナダのスタートアップ調査に従事するため
Daikin
U.S.に駐在。ボストンオフィスを開設し，スタートアップとのPoC，共同研究，11大学との連携を立ち上げた。
デジタルヘルスのスタートアップでは，日米間の医療データの取扱いの違いから，医療機器，電子 当サイトの改良、サービス案内、閲覧状況分析などに利用するため、
当サイト上でのクッキー（Cookie）の使用に同意ください。

第一三共株式会社）に入社し市販後調査部門に配属し感染症領域、癌領域を担当。2004年、株式会社UFJキャピ
タル（現
三菱UFJキャピタル株式会社）に入社しアナリストを経て、キャピタリストに従事。第一三共との共同でオープ
ンイノベーション・ファンド（OiDEファンド）を活用したアカデミア発研究成果をもとに創薬基盤技術に育成す
る試みを2013年より展開（2023年終了）。2017年の１号ファンド以降、「三菱UFJライフサイエンス4号ファンド
」（200億円）を含め計500億円を活用した投資活動を推進。現在、カムイファーマ(株)、（株）ガイアバイオメ
ディシン、（株）Luxonus社外取締役、京都大学医学研究科「医学領域」産学連携推進機構・産学連携フェロー

2017年から米国ボストン在住。以降，投資家，スタートアップ，政府系アクセラレーターなど複数の視点・立場
から，一貫してボストンのスタートアップエコシステムに関わる。
ダイキン工業にて，NAISTとの包括連携を立ち上げ，大学内に実施拠点を開設し，1億円のプロジェクトをリード
，葉緑体形質転換レタスによるPlant-made
Pharmaceuticalの研究を3研究科の教授と実行，7名を雇用，16件の特許出願した。研究職から新規事業へ転進後
，始動を含む多くのビジネスモデルコンペに選抜され，イスラエルのヤングリーダーに選ばれ国費派遣された。
そのイントレプレナーシップを買われ，米国東海岸，イスラエル，カナダのスタートアップ調査に従事するため
Daikin
U.S.に駐在。ボストンオフィスを開設し，スタートアップとのPoC，共同研究，11大学との連携を立ち上げた。
デジタルヘルスのスタートアップでは，日米間の医療データの取扱いの違いから，医療機器，電子カルテ，Real
World Evidenceのクライアントとの連携を確立した。 CIC本社Japan
Deskでは，JETROと連携し，日本の創薬・医療機器スタートアップの米国進出を支援するアクセラレーションプ
ログラムをデザイン・運営した。
現在は，VCのポートフォリオ企業ハンズオン支援と顧客開発，日本、米国のearly-stageの創薬スタートアップ
の日米国進出，資金調達を支援している。遊び情報も含んだ最新のボストンの情報をSNSで配信中。バイオ・ラ
イフサイエンス分野の日本語話者のコミュニティBoston Biotech Hubを運営。

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

help ensure the medicines of today and tomorrow can be made quickly, safely, sustainably, and at

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Pioneering the Development of Automated Technologies for Cell-Based Therapeutics and
## Bioprocessing

*For more than two decades ThermoGenesis has developed and commercialized novel cell processing
systems and devices providing global researchers, biomanufacturing organizations and clinicians with
highly efficient cell processing devices which helped them to deliver better outcomes in various
applications in the cell and gene therapy field.*

**Advancing Cell and Gene Therapies From Lab to Clinic**

With decades of experience, we deliver innovative solutions that support every stage of the cell
therapy workflow — from biobanking and point-of-care processing to scalable, clinical-grade
manufacturing. Explore how our technologies are helping researchers, clinicians, and institutions
move science forward with confidence.

**Clinical BioBanking**

**With over 20 years of providing cord blood to banks hospitals, researchers and stem clinicians
with systems designed to handle stem cells with the highest level of precision, safety, and
confidence.**

[Learn More][20]

**Cellular Processing**

**The first step in the process is often the most important. That’s why we have created
closed-system novel and innovative technologies aimed at advancing cell therapies to the clinic.**

[Learn More][21]

**Products for Cellular Processing and Storage**

We offer closed automated solutions for manual steps in the cell manufacturing process. Our flexible
automated modules provide performance gains in purifying mononuclear cells, washing contaminants
from cell fractions, cell selection, and storage while significantly shortening processing times.

## Tại sao nên chọn Vinmec?

[why chose us]
[Chuyên gia giàu kinh nghiệm]

### Chuyên gia giàu kinh nghiệm

Vinmec quy tụ đội ngũ chuyên gia, bác sĩ, dược sĩ và điều dưỡng có trình độ chuyên môn cao, tay nghề
giỏi, tận tâm và chuyên nghiệp. Luôn đặt người bệnh làm trung tâm, Vinmec cam kết đem đến dịch vụ
chăm sóc sức khỏe tốt cho khách hàng.
[Chất lượng quốc tế]

### Chất lượng quốc tế

Hệ thống Y tế Vinmec được quản lý và vận hành dưới sự giám sát của những nhà quản lý y tế giàu kinh
nghiệm, cùng với sự hỗ trợ của phương tiện kỹ thuật hiện đại, nhằm đảm bảo cung cấp dịch vụ chăm sóc
sức khỏe toàn diện và hiệu quả.
[Công nghệ tiên tiến]

### Công nghệ tiên tiến

Vinmec cung cấp cơ sở chất lượng và dịch vụ 5 sao bằng cách sử dụng các công nghệ tiên tiến được
quản lý bởi các bác sĩ lâm sàng lành nghề để đảm bảo dịch vụ chăm sóc sức khỏe toàn diện và hiệu quả
cao
[Nghiên cứu & Đổi mới]

### Nghiên cứu & Đổi mới

Vinmec liên tục thúc đẩy y học hàn lâm dựa trên nghiên cứu có phương pháp và sự phát triển y tế được
chia sẻ từ quan hệ đối tác toàn cầu với các hệ thống chăm sóc sức khỏe trên thế giới nhằm cung cấp
các phương pháp điều trị mang tính cách mạng và sáng tạo cho tiêu chuẩn chăm sóc bệnh nhân.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
